spans.s:
m. (-मः)
A pin, a stake.
E.
नि in, माञ् to plunge or stick, affix ड; stuck in the ground.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Plunged in, immersed.
E.
नि in, मस्ज to bathe, affix क्त.

mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जत्)
Bathing, plunging in.
E.
नि before मस्ज to bathe, शतृ aff.

m. (-थुः)
Sleep, sleeping.
E.
नि in, मस्ज to bathe, अथु aff.

Bathing.
2

Immersion.
E.
नि before मस्ज to bathe, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Summoning, calling.
2 Inviting, invitation.
E.
नि affirmative, मन्त्रण advising.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Summoned, convoked.
2 Invited.
E.
नि before मन्त्र to advise, affix क्त.

m. (-यः)
Barter, exchange.
E.
नि before मि to measure, to mete, affix अच्.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be exchanged or bartered.
E.
नि before मा to measure, तव्य aff.

m. (-मिः)
A son of IKṢVĀKU, condemned to reside in the twinkle of the eye.

n. (-त्तं)
1 Cause, motive, instrumental cause.
2 Mark, sign, spot, trace, token.
3 Omen.
E.
नि before मि to measure, क्त affix; also with कन् added निमित्तक.

n. (-कं)
1 Kissing, a kiss.
2 Cause, &c.
E.
see the last.

n. (-णं)
The instrumental cause, the material or the agent, especially the deity considered as the agent in creation.
E.
निमित्त the instrumental cause, कारण cause.

m. (-लः)
Any given or specific time.
E.
निमित्त, and काल time.

n. (-त्वं)
Causality, instrumentality.
E.
निमित्त, and त्व affix; also with तल्, निमित्तता.

Expiation.
2

Any occasional or special penance, rite, or obligation.
E.
निमित्त, and धर्म्म piety.

n. (-त्रं)
The mere agent or instrument.
E.
निमित्त, and मात्र alone.

m. (-विद्)
An astrologer.
E.
निमित्त a mark, (lucky or unlucky,) and विद् who knows.

f. (-त्तिः)
Dependance upon a special cause or occasion.
E.
निमित्त, and आवृत्ति revolving.

m. (-षः)
1 Twinkling of the eye.
2 The twinkling of an eye, considered as a measure of time.
3 A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
नि before मिष to twinkle, affix क; also with घञ् affix निमेष, or निमि a proper name, षद to go, ड aff.

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Blinking, closing the eyelids.
E.
निमिष to twinkle, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
Twinkling, closing, (as the eye.)
E.
नि before मील to disappear, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Death, dying.
2 Twinkling of the eye, shutting of the eyelids, winking.
E.
नि before मील to disappear, &c. affix ल्युट्.

f. (-का)
1 Fraud, trick, disguise.
2 Twinkling of the eye, winking, blinking.
E.
नि before मील to twinkle, affix वुन् and टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Closed, (as the eyelid,) twinkled, blinked.
E.
नि before मील to disappear, क्त aff.

m. (-यः)
Barter, exchange.
E.
नि before मि to measure affix यत्.

m. (-षः)
1 Twinkling of the eye.
2 A momentary space of time, a twinkling of the eye considered as a measure of time: see निमिष.

m. (-कः)
1 Twinkling of the eye.
2 A firefly.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (कृत्)
Lightning.
E.
निमेष twinkling, and कृत् what makes.

m. (-रुक्)
A firefly.
E.
निमेष a twinkling, रुच् who shines.

mfn. (-म्नः-म्ना-म्नं)
Deep, profound, (literally or figuratively.)
E.
नि before म्ना to mind, affix क.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Deep, going deep.
f. (-गा)
A river.
E.
निम्न deep, and ग what goes.

f. (-ता)
Depth, profundity.
E.
निम्न with तल् affix; also with त्व, निम्नत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
High and low, up and down.
E.
निम्न, and उन्नत high.

m. (-म्बः)
The Nimb or Neemb tree, (Melia azadiracta.)
E.
निबि to sprinkle, affix अच्; also with कन् added, निम्बकः these words are written with either ब or व, as निम्ब or निम्व.

m. (-रुः)
The Coral tree, (Erythrina fulgens); it is considered as one of the trees of paradise.
E.
निम्ब as above, and तरु a tree.

m. (-कः)
The common lime, (Citrus acida.)
